Press Briefing | CEO, Puducherry

Special Intensive Revision (SIR) has 3 phases — Phase 1 completed.

🔹 Voters before SIR: 10,21,578
🔹 Voters after SIR: 9,18,111
🔹 ~10% names deleted

Deletion breakup:
• Deceased: 20,798 (2%)
• Shifted: 80,615 (8%)
• Duplicate: 2,100

Total voters excluded post-SIR: 1,03,467

Highest deletions: Kamarajar Nagar, Raj Bhavan, Karaikal North & South
Lowest: Mahe – 898

— Jawahar, IAS

#SIR2026 #Puducherry #ElectoralRoll #VoterList #ECI #Democracy
